newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt overnight pound rates rise.
newsitem.headline: Egypt overnight pound rates rise.

text.p: The Egyptian pound interbank market was short on Sunday with overnight rates at 10-1/8 and 10-7/16, up from 10 and 10-3/8 percent on Thursday, bankers said.
But one said that he saw the market as "rather liquid. We have some Egyptian pounds we're trying to place."
Bankers said one week rates were 10-1/8 to 10-3/8. One banker had said on Thursday, the last day the market was open, that he heard one week rates were 10-3/8 percent that day.
State-owned banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rate at 10-1/2 percent, bankers said.
